identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Tislelizumab, Chemotherapy, and Radiation Therapy for Early-Stage High-Risk ENKTCL (CLCG-2102)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Tislelizumab Plus Dose-Dense P-GemOx and Radiation Therapy for Early-Stage Intermediate/High-Risk Extranodal NK/T-Cell Lymphoma: A Multicenter Phase II Trial

leadSponsor.name: Cancer Institute and Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

The First Hospital of Jilin University

The First Affiliated Hospital of Dalian Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The current study is a phase II multi-center single arm trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of inductive Anti-PD-1+P-GEMOX treatment followed by radiotherapy and concurrent Anti-PD-1 antibody in early-stage Intermediate/High-Risk extranodal NK/T cell lymphoma

armGroups.label: Inductive and concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody combined with chemo-radiotherapy
armGroups.description: All the enrolled patients receive 3 cycles of anti-PD-1 antibody (Tislelizumab 200mg d1) + P-GEMOX (Pegaspargase 3000u d2, Gemcitabine 1g/m2 d2, Oxaliplatin 85mg/m2 d2) systemic treatment every 14 days, followed by involved-site radiotherapy with concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody (Tislelizumab 200mg) every two weeks.

interventions.name: Anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody
interventions.description: 200mg iv on Day 1 of each 14-day cycle for 3 cycles in induction treatment; 200mg iv on Day 1,15, 29 during RT treatment
armGroupLabels: Inductive and concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody combined with chemo-radiotherapy

interventions.name: Pegaspargase
interventions.description: 3000 IU im on Day 2 of each 14-day cycle for 3 cycles in induction treatment
armGroupLabels: Inductive and concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody combined with chemo-radiotherapy

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: 1g/m2 iv on Day 2 of each 14-day cycle for 3 cycles in induction treatment
armGroupLabels: Inductive and concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody combined with chemo-radiotherapy

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: 85 mg/m2 iv on Day 2 of each 14-day cycle for 3 cycles in induction treatment
armGroupLabels: Inductive and concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody combined with chemo-radiotherapy

interventions.name: Involved site radiotherapy
interventions.description: Involved site radiotherapy according to the ILROG guideline with primary tumor dose of 50Gy 14-28 days after inductive therapy
armGroupLabels: Inductive and concurrent anti-PD-1 antibody combined with chemo-radiotherapy

primaryOutcomes.measure: Complete Response rate after 3 cycles of Anti-PD-1 antibody and P-GEMOX therapy
primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the complete response (CR) rate after 3 cycles of Anti-PD-1 antibody and P-GEMOX therapy according to Lyric 2016 criteria
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of Cycle 3 (each cycle is 14 days)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-free survival rate at year 2 after enrollment, 2y-PFS
secondaryOutcomes.description: From enrollment to disease progression or any death

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall Survival rate at year 2/5 after enrollment，2y-/5y-OS

secondaryOutcomes.description: evaluated according to the CTCAE criteria
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to 3 months after treatment

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Biopsy proved extranodal NK/T cell lymphoma
* No previous anti-cancer treatment
* Measurable lesion on baseline PET/CT and MRI
* Stage I-II
* Have at lest one following risk factor: Elevated serum LDH level; PTI+; stage II
* ECOG PS 0-1
* Sufficient organ functions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other mature T- or NK- lymphoma
* Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis
* Primary CNS lymphoma or CNS-involved lymphoma
* History of malignancy except for cutaneous basal-/squamous- cell carcinoma or cervical carcinoma in situ 3 years prior to study treatment
